faqs.a: Yes — you can create an account and start learning the Armenian alphabet and your first lessons for free.

faqs.q: I don't know the Armenian alphabet at all. Is that okay?
faqs.a: Perfect, that's exactly where we begin. The first lessons introduce each letter with its sound, examples, and typing practice before you ever build a word.

faqs.q: Do I need a special keyboard?
faqs.a: No. Exercises are tap-and-choose or use on-screen prompts, and typing exercises accept the Armenian letters shown to you.

faqs.q: Does it work on my phone?
faqs.a: Yes. Haylingua is built mobile-first and works in any modern browser on phone, tablet, or desktop.

faqs.q: How do streaks and hearts work?
faqs.a: You earn XP for correct answers and keep a daily streak by practicing each day. Hearts give you a few tries per session so mistakes feel low-stakes.
